verdicts.reason: A: the bottle badge is shrunk and jammed into the top-left corner, with its cap almost touching the edge, and the decorative circle is cropped. The NEW pill and Try It button are oversized and right-aligned, while the headline is left-aligned, so nothing shares an edge and the CTA competes with the headline. The lower-left is dead space. B: a clear two-column layout with a large hero bottle on the left, and the headline, NEW badge and CTA sharing one left edge with a sensible size order. But everything sits in the top two-thirds, leaving the bottom third of the canvas empty. The bottle spills well past its cream circle, and the faint stray circle top-right looks accidental.
